name: Tsuu
source:
Nickname "Otsuu", one of the Chishiski Girls who is a member of Daybreak and the protagonist of the second game. When she and [url=/c68684]Ningyohime[/url] were younger, Tsuu promised to become the "little mermaid's true prince", and thus, has always acted like a prince. Tsuu is very courageous, though underneath her shell she also has a slightly weak and girlish personality that contrasts her boyish appearance.

She is also the only one who can understand and interact with [url=/c68685]Jack[/url].
